cursor_rule: Keep the 'c' of the newest event you processed. Next read, take every event whose 'c' is strictly greater as a plain string comparison. id = c.split('|', 1)[1].
on_gap: If undated is non-empty, ordering is incomplete: read recent.json. Otherwise, if your cursor sorts below complete_since, this shard does not cover your gap: read feed/window.json, then recent.json if that is also short.
